corrected_findings.scenario: Changing the runtime and record hosting revision left a passed hosted_pair check from the previous pair eligible because it checked only the brain revision.
corrected_findings.resolution: The hosted_pair check must name the exact hosting revision as well as the brain revision. A red regression reproduced the stale approval; the final focused and affected suites pass.
